v2_subject.rule: Changing the V2 subject after any paired outcome is observed creates a new protocol identity.

comparison_contract.unit: one frozen V1 capability opportunity within one parity case

hostile_controls: direct case where decomposition is unnecessary and added V2 work is overreach
coupled case where independent decomposition breaks a global constraint
authority-required case where a correct candidate cannot self-adopt
censored route cannot become evidence of absence
one route may stop while the task remains open
source identity/lineage must survive retrieval

campaigns.purpose: scientific-language absorption and native semantic binding
hostile_controls: same words with different native structure
different words with same registered structure
ambiguous identity/context must be quarantined rather than normalized
source projection must remain recoverable after mapping
pairwise local compatibility with a global obstruction
multiple justified portraits with no unique collapse
new representation opens a previously absent search route

campaigns.purpose: detection, discriminating diagnosis and plural responsibility
hostile_controls: missing evidence is not contradiction
structural non-identifiability is not resource failure
multiple independent faults
interaction-only responsibility
earliest-stage attribution is correct only on serial-upstream controls

campaigns.purpose: reframe, transport, repair and selective reopen
hostile_controls: local repair sufficient so higher Jump is overreach
model expansion sufficient so representation transition is overreach
true representation insufficiency with correspondence/preservation obligations
one support invalidates while an alternative support remains
unaffected commitments must not reopen
flat growth under incomplete route coverage is not saturation
changed-vocabulary omission challenge discovers a material parent
two complete no-material-change passes are required for closeout saturation

campaigns.purpose: authority, review, benchmark and experiment-selection custody
hostile_controls: same-model or same-data reviewers are not counted as independent
protected evaluator identity cannot change after proposal access
high expected score cannot compensate an authority/integrity violation
unexercised experiment-selection arm cannot be reported as safe

campaigns.purpose: memory, experience, real execution and bounded context
hostile_controls: missing mandatory memory cannot be silently truncated
negative experience cannot be deleted by a successful successor
provider/tool timeout or execution failure is not a scientific negative
declared execution identity must be compared, not merely well formed

blocked_on: bind exact post-contraction V2 subject commit
freeze matched resource budgets and custody
